main.description: Lists indexed attachments with optional publisher, record URI, subject URI, and content-type filters. Values within each array filter use OR; distinct filters use AND, and duplicate values are ignored. Authentication is not required.

uris.description: Attachment AT-URIs with DID authorities to include; matching uses URI only, not CID/version. Results follow sort order, not input order.

subjects.description: Match any record.subjects[].uri against these AT-URIs with DID authorities; CID values are ignored.

contentTypes.description: Exact matches on record.contentType; this is not a file MIME-type filter.

sortDirection.description: Sort direction by (createdAt, uri); defaults to desc.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor tied to sortDirection; keep all other parameters unchanged between pages.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: A filter value, cursor, sort direction, page size, or query parameter is invalid.

errors.name: AttachmentQueryFailed
errors.description: The attachment query or required publisher hydration failed.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; omitted when there is no next page.
